extraction.title: UN DEFINED PROBLEMS
key_claims: Thinking deeply about the future helps understand potential opportunities and problems.
Analyzing trends and scenarios can reveal ill-defined problems and potential solutions.

questions:
UN-DEFINED PROBLEMS

Tools for exploring un-defined problems
Problem Types
Un-Defined Problems
Goal is to think deeply about the future in order to understand what is over the horizon and the opportunities and problems that might possibly be found there
Examples:
What is the future of personal mobility?
What is the future of work?
What will the transition to clean energy look like?
What problems and opportunities will be found in these futures?
Example: What is the Future of Medical Care?
Possibilities:
Precision medicine
Big data
Early cancer detection
Immunotherapy
